text:
Lina (Support): Escalating to CS  were seeing a short burst of provisioning failures impacting trial tenants (Northbridge, Emberlytics). Frontend shows "activation_pending" and a couple of 500s from /v1/provision. Northbridge has a renewal touchpoint in 48h, marking as high priority.

Omar (CS): Thanks Lina. Can you paste error IDs and approx impact (how many tenants/users)? We'll need a calm customer note + a quick mitigation plan.

Lina (Support): Logs/snips: 
```
2026-12-02T09:10:11Z ERROR provisioner: quota_bind_failed req=req_nbr22 tenant=northbridge
2026-12-02T09:10:13Z ERROR cache: lease_timeout req=req_em11 tenant=emberlytics
2026-12-02T09:10:15Z WARN proxy: upstream 502 -> webhook retry tenant=emberlytics
```
Impact: ~9 trials hit, 3 high-touch tenants. Some customers reporting repeated retry toasts in the UI.

deploy-bot: Alert: recent config push reduced ephemeral pool size for new tenants. Hotfix queued: restore pool size + restart provisioners. Expected mitigation in ~25m.

Priya (CS Ops): I'm flagging Northbridge as renewal-risk in CRM and drafting outreach. Draft below, please review: 

"Hi <Name>, quick note from Redwood: we're investigating an internal provisioning issue affecting activations for a small set of trial accounts, including yours. Our engineers are deploying a fix now. If you'd like immediate help we can run a targeted manual provisioning and schedule a 15-min check-in. If not resolved within 24 hours we'll proactively extend your trial by 7 days. Apologies for the interruption and thanks for your patience."

Sam (CS Manager): Good tone. Add one line pointing to the support ticket and a named contact: "Omar (CS) - omar@redwood.ai". Also prep a short sales-facing blurb so Sales knows what to say on renewal calls.

Lina (Support): Temporary unblock: manual admin provision works for many VIPs. Steps: 
```
Admin UI -> Tenants -> Actions -> Manual provision
CLI: ./admin tools provision --tenant <tenant_id> --force
```
Note: audit log will record admin ID; use for VIPs only.

Omar (CS): I'll send the outreach to Northbridge + Emberlytics and CC Sales. Sam, please confirm standard credit policy (7 days) and whether to escalate credits.

Sam (CS Manager): Confirm 7-day extension as standard. Escalate any request for monetary credit to Sales leadership. I'll post a quick comms template in #customer-success-ops and a one-liner for Sales.

deploy-bot: Hotfix applied; provisioner pool restored and workers restarted. Provision success rate improved to ~96% over last 10m. Continuing monitoring and will run targeted re-provisions for flagged tenants.

Priya (CS Ops): Action items: 1) Omar send outreach (now) and flag CRM; 2) Priya queue a re-provision batch when eng confirms; 3) Lina run manual provision for any VIPs that request immediate unblock; 4) Sam CC Sales on outreach and hold credit negotiations. I'll also add a short post-incident note to /docs/cs/incidents.

Lina (Support): Patch looks good; re-provision batch started for flagged tenants. Early verifier checks show Northbridge active again. Will post final confirmation when sweep completes.

Omar (CS): Outreach sent to Northbridge + Emberlytics (cc Sales). Requested permission to run manual provision for Northbridge; they accepted and Lina validated activation end-to-end. CRM renewal flag updated.

Sam (CS Manager): Great work. Please keep the CRM updated with any customer replies and escalate any credit asks. I'll close the loop once post-incident note is in place. :thumbsup:
